summary: We have developed an HTML file with an easy-to-use UI. Our project includes 15 different space vehicles abandoned on the Moon. We included key points regarding these vehicles. We researched the history carefully and used AI to prevent any case of misinformation. We made this project so that the youth could enjoy it. We believe that our project can spark new ideas and imagination among kids.
details: Our project is an HTML, which allows us to make basic websites. Our website features 15 navigation buttons that take you to 15 different vehicles. It also features a search bar. The info is given as timelines, achievements, and even interesting facts. We made it so that students can have the most out of our project. We used Google and NASA for individual research, used multiple AI (SI) tools to do further research, checked all of the info, and used ChatGPT to create our HTML. We made sure we use an outstanding methods such as using SVG images for visuals to avoid any viewing and copyright issues. We considered the fact that our HTML has an easily understandable user interface.
